headline: Land A Return From Delta Air Lines Stock — Any Which Way It Travels
summary: Delta Air Lines stock is currently trading with a very low implied volatility rank, meaning options are cheap compared to the last 12 months.  Delta Air Lines is a major U.S. carrier headquartered in Atlanta, where it operates at the world's busiest airport as its primary hub.
